footer.tagline: An independent, open-source fact-checking project for Kenya.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: fact_checker_ke couldn't reach the network. The app shell is cached, so pages you've already visited may still work — reconnect to submit a new claim or load fresh checks.

draft.awaitingEditor: Awaiting editor review. Evidence and sources are shown below, but no rating is published until an editor signs off.

check.reviewedBy: Reviewed by an editor before publishing

notFound.title: Check not found
notFound.body: We couldn't find a check with that id.

submit.heading: fact_checker_ke
submit.lede: Submit a link or paste text. We transcribe, extract claims, run retrieval against known sources, and draft a verdict — always reviewed by a human before it is published.

smartInput.placeholder: Paste a link, or type what they said…
smartInput.label: Paste a link or type a claim

detected.text: Free text — we'll check this claim directly

moment.heading: Mark the moment + the claim
moment.help: Drag to the moment they said it, then type or paste exactly what they said — we check that quoted text, we never download or clip the video itself.
moment.noEmbed: We don't have a live preview for this platform yet — the link itself is still submitted and checked.

upload.heading: Or share your own photo or video
upload.help: Drag a file here, click to browse, or paste from your clipboard.
upload.trust: Uploads are scanned and stripped of location/device data on our server before any human reviews them (ADR-0027).
upload.rights: I own this media or have the right to share it, it is not of a minor, and I consent to its use for fact-checking.

submit.awaitingReview: Awaiting review — not a verdict yet
submit.success: Submitted. Watch it move through the pipeline.

error.offline: You're offline — submitting a new claim needs a connection.
error.empty: Paste a link or type a claim before submitting.

status.heading: Tracking your submission

desc.received: Your submission is queued for analysis.
desc.analyzing: Extracting claims and translating, keeping the original words.
desc.analyzed: Claims extracted. Matching each one against credible sources.
desc.verifying: A human editor is reviewing the evidence and draft verdict.
desc.failed: Something went wrong processing this submission.

status.polling: Live updates unavailable — checking periodically instead.

tracker.heading: Maandamano advisories
tracker.intro: Read-only advisories by ward and sub-county. No precise locations are published.
tracker.streetHeading: When the streets move, the rumours move faster.
tracker.streetBody: During maandamano, fact_checker_ke tracks confirmed advisories at the ward level — road closures, safety notices, and the claims going viral about them. We show what's happening and where, never who is where.
tracker.streetNote: Protester safety comes before engagement. Locations stay coarse, and anything that could put people at risk is held or dropped.

frozen.title: Tracker temporarily frozen
frozen.body: Advisories are paused while we confirm current conditions. This is a deliberate safety measure, not an outage — check back shortly.

offline.title: Can't confirm current status
offline.body: We never show a cached advisory as current. Reconnect to see the latest status.

tracker.staleWarning: Not re-verified in over 2 hours — status may be out of date.

editorial.heading: Editor review
editorial.devBanner: Dev-only stub: real session auth lands with ADR-0020 (Better Auth). You are viewing this as a pretend-logged-in editor.
editorial.noRatingToSubmitter: Rating withheld from the submitter until published (AT-0004-B).
